scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.rmSync('out',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync('out');for(const f of ['index.html','styles.css','main.js','404.html','assets','privacy-policy','terms-and-conditions','disclaimer','favicon.ico','robots.txt','sitemap.xml','_headers']){fs.cpSync(f,'out/'+f,{recursive:true})}console.log('Site built in out/')"
